outcome: Delivery by a skilled birth attendant (SBA)
cohort: 762 women in Yangon region, Myanmar who gave birth within the 12-month survey period (October to November 2016)
finding: While there was no overall inequity in antenatal care utilization, significant inequities were found in delivery by cesarean section and skilled birth attendants, particularly related to age and education.
mod_finding: Delivery by cesarean section was disproportionately higher in adolescents and women with higher education than middle school.
